spec_questions: T1.3: Object/commit content-addressing format and history() ordering — §4.4/§4.5 name objects.bytes/commits.hash but do not pin down (a) the node-content blob byte layout (implemented as canonical-JSON {body,facets,task_state}, kind=node_snapshot), (b) whether commits.hash is content-addressed (chose sha256 of canonical-JSON, git-style) or a minted id8, (c) history() ordering (chose oldest-first). Narrowest reading; self-contained within store.py.
